name: context-meter
description: Shows context window usage as a single line after every turn, and warns the model when the window is running out.

CONTEXT_WINDOW.title: Context window, tokens
CONTEXT_WINDOW.description: Leave empty to detect it from the model name.

YELLOW_AT.title: Yellow from, %
YELLOW_AT.description: Below this the line is printed without formatting.

RED_AT.title: Red from, %
RED_AT.description: Takes precedence over the yellow threshold.

WARN_AT.title: Warn the model at, %
WARN_AT.description: Adds a short notice about the upcoming auto-compact to the next prompt. Set to 100 to disable.
